text:
sarah: Heads-up: RC deploy tomorrow 10:00 PT. We're doing code freeze at 06:00 PT. If you need a late merge, please request exception here with reason and risk. @hiro @dana @omar

hiro: Planning a doc-only bump to changelog for props handling. Can that be merged post-freeze? Small JSON-only change. @release-bot do we need a PR review label?

dana: If it's docs-only and doesn't touch runtime we usually allow quick cherry-picks. Ping me +1 if CI green. Also update changelog owner.

omar: PR #7892 is the bump. CI flaky on windows, but not relevant. Requesting exception for copy change.

sarah: Please include a one-liner for changelog and link to QA checklist. We'll approve if tests are green. Also add `freeze-exception` label.

hiro: Got it. Adding label and changelog entry. CI passing locally. @release-bot can you queue the exception?

release-bot: Exception request logged: PR #7892, requester: hiro, category: docs, risk: low. @sarah to approve within 2 hours.

dana: Approved. @hiro go ahead to merge after CI passes and @sarah gives final thumbs.

sarah: :thumbsup: I'll watch CI and merge if green. @omar can you run a quick smoke in staging?

omar: Running smoke now, ETA 8m. Report back.

omar: Smoke passed. All good.

sarah: Merging now. Reminder: if anything touches runtime path (embeddings/serving), exceptions won't be granted post-freeze. Keep that in mind.

hiro: Thanks all. Sorry for last-minute, won't repeat.

dana: :raised_hands: nice and quick.

hiro: Example cherry-pick flow:
```
git fetch origin
git checkout -b cherry-pick/changelog-7892
git cherry-pick -x <commit>
git push origin HEAD
```

sarah: Noted. Closing the exception once merged.
